name: yoinks
tagline: Grab any video from your terminal, no shady ads
description: yoinks is a terminal video downloader that fetches videos from YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, and 1,800+ other sites without popups, fake download buttons, or sketchy redirects. Paste a URL, pick a resolution or audio-only MP3, and it is done. The full-screen interface is built with Ink, React for the terminal: format picker with estimated file sizes, mouse support, and an auto theme that follows your terminal's light or dark palette. It is powered by yt-dlp, which is fetched automatically on first run with no Python required, and ffmpeg is found on PATH or bundled as a fallback. Files land in your Downloads folder and the path is printed when finished.
highlights: Downloads from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, and 1,800+ other sites
No popups, no fake download buttons, no wrapper-site redirects
Full-screen Ink interface with resolution picker, MP3 mode, and mouse support
Bundles yt-dlp on first run — no Python required, ffmpeg fallback included
Theme follows your terminal automatically, with light and dark overrides
curatorNote: A no-frills terminal video downloader that rode the wave of terminal-first tooling, past 1.2k stars mid-window. It is a rare downloader that is genuinely pleasant to use — full-screen, theme-aware, and zero ads.
